findings.defect: Claims the ceremony proceeded without disruption, rather than merely ending successfully.
findings.rationale: 성공적으로 끝났지 states the result, not that nothing went wrong along the way.

findings.current: “Long time no see, Emmanuel. You miserable little rat. I ought to tear you limb from limb.”
findings.defect: Loses Hagel’s assertion that even tearing Emmanuel apart and killing him would not satisfy him.
findings.rationale: 찢어 죽여도 시원치 않을 explicitly says that killing him that way would still not be satisfying.
findings.replacement: “Long time no see, Emmanuel. You little rat—I could tear you apart and kill you, and it still wouldn’t be enough.”
findings.source: 이 찢어 죽여도 시원치 않을 쥐새끼 같으니.

findings.defect: Turns confirmation that Emmanuel is sufficiently alive into a prediction of recovery.
findings.rationale: The exchange asks whether he survived; Hagel’s next order is only to keep him breathing.

findings.current: “Bastard. Did you think I’d say yes?”
findings.defect: Adds a question about Emmanuel’s expectations instead of dismissing his request as absurd.
findings.rationale: 그걸 말이라고 rebukes the question itself.
findings.replacement: “Asshole. What kind of question was that?”

findings.current: They kept at it until the day a young man, who’d fallen into a deep sleep, finally awoke.
findings.defect: Implies the operation stopped when the young man woke.
findings.rationale: 그 날까지도 emphasizes that their work continued even on that day; it does not mark its end.
findings.replacement: Even on the day a young man finally woke from his deep sleep, they were still at it.
findings.source: 마침내 깊은 잠에 빠졌던 한 청년이 깨어나던 그 날까지도.

summary: Several lines change the outcome or force of the source; the final line also incorrectly implies the operation ended.
